reproduction.script_source:
import json,hashlib,pathlib,subprocess,re,tempfile,tarfile,io
R=pathlib.Path('/home/mii/code/konOSuba/biomiya');D=R/'docs/workflows/bootstrap-b31';old=R/'docs/workflows/bootstrap-b3'
h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
run=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(a,cwd=R)
b=json.loads((D/'baseline.json').read_text());c=json.loads((D/'N0-r1-candidate.json').read_text());prior=json.loads((old/'I-r2-review.json').read_text())
assert run('git','rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==b['commit']
for p,s in c['files'].items():assert h((R/p).read_bytes())==s,p
for p,s in b['files'].items():
 assert h((R/p).read_bytes())==s,p
 assert h(run('git','show',b['commit']+':'+p))==s,p
tracked=set(run('git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',b['commit'],'core-s').decode().splitlines());assert tracked<=set(b['files']),tracked-set(b['files'])
assert h((R/b['seed_path']).read_bytes())==b['seed_sha256']==prior['final_artifacts']['hashes']['c2']
for p,s in prior['author_evidence_hashes_verified'].items():assert h((old/p).read_bytes())==s,p
for p,s in prior['file_hashes_verified'].items():assert h((R/p).read_bytes())==s,p
for p,s in prior['independent_evidence'].items():assert h((old/p).read_bytes())==s,p
counts={}
for p in ['I-r2-tests.txt','I-r2-clean/I-clean-tests.txt']:
 counts[p]=sum(map(int,re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed',(old/p).read_text())))
 assert counts[p]==81
archive=run('git','archive',b['commit'])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='b31-n0-restore-') as t:
 root=pathlib.Path(t)
 with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as f:f.extractall(root,filter='data')
 for p,s in b['files'].items():assert h((root/p).read_bytes())==s,p
 assert (root/'docs/workflows/bootstrap-b3/clean_build.py').exists()
 assert (root/'docs/workflows/bootstrap-b3/I-r2-review.json').read_bytes()==(old/'I-r2-review.json').read_bytes()
 assert (root/'core-s/bootstrap/c1.build').exists() and (root/'core-s/Cargo.lock').exists()
workflow=json.loads((D/'workflow.json').read_text());nodes={x['id']:x for x in workflow['nodes']};seen=set()
for n in workflow['nodes']:
 assert set(n['dependencies'])<=seen
 seen.add(n['id'])
assert [x['id'] for x in workflow['nodes']]==['N0','N1','N2','N3','N4','N5']
